description: This Java interface defines a repository for accessing and manipulating SavingsAccount entities in the database. It extends JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor, providing various custom query methods using Spring Data JPA annotations for retrieving savings accounts based on different criteria such as client ID, status, account number, and more.

methods.name: findSavingAccountByClientId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of SavingsAccount entities associated with a specific client ID.

methods.name: findSavingAccountByGsimId
methods.description: Retrieves savings accounts linked to a particular gsim ID.

methods.name: findSavingAccountByStatus
methods.description: Fetches savings accounts matching a specific account status.

methods.name: findByClientIdAndGroupId
methods.description: Finds savings accounts associated with both a client and a group.

methods.name: doNonClosedSavingAccountsExistForClient
methods.description: Checks if there are any non-closed savings accounts for a specific client.

methods.name: findByGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves savings accounts linked to a specific group ID where client is null.

methods.name: findByIdAndDepositAccountType
methods.description: Finds a savings account by its ID and deposit account type.

methods.name: findNonClosedAccountByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds a non-closed savings account by its account number.

methods.name: findSavingsAccountByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds a savings account by account number regardless of status.

methods.name: findByStatus
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of savings accounts filtered by status.

methods.name: findByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves a savings account by its external ID.

methods.name: findIdByExternalId
methods.description: Fetches the internal database ID for a savings account given its external ID.

methods.name: findAccrualData
methods.description: Obtains accrual data for savings accounts based on criteria like date, status, and accounting rule.

methods.name: findSavingsAccountIdsByStatusId
methods.description: Lists IDs of savings accounts that match a given status ID.
